As the search for the letter unfolds, alliances are formed, secrets are revealed, and no one can stop the truth that is destined to leave its mark in history.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 做個有錢人
programme.desc: Success in business, having a happy family, and being a rich one is what most people wish for. This is also the wish of the young man A Hwa! Those who are hardworking, responsible and know how to be grateful will surely be rich and become wealthy.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：劉青雲: 毒。誡
programme.desc: This is a true story based on a repented gangster preaching the word of God and guiding his brotherhood to turn over a new leaf. Chen once was the leader of the famous gang “The 13 Tsz Wan Shan”, he lost his family, lovers, brothers and finally ended up imprisoned for his drug abuse and trafficking. After jail, he devoted himself to save the lost fellows and was selected as “The JCI Hong Kong Ten Outstanding Young Persons”. Being respected by the world, Chen is always asked to solve the most difficult situations between evil and good. People give him a nickname “The Fixer”. However, there are two sides of a coin, Chen can work out any problem of others, he does not know how to deal with his personal knot with his love, with whom he has had guilty conscience all his life. Can he fix it eventually.

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t.

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童鬧海（粵語配音版
programme.desc: Ne Zha returns again joining by versatile stars - Jennifer Yu, Fish Liew and Peter Chan, who bring their unique voices and witty dialogue to the adventures of Ne Zha and Ao Bing and breathe a new life into the story. After the heavenly lightning, although Ne Zha and Ao Bing survived by becoming spirits, they would soon dissipate completely. Taiyi plans to rebuild Ne Zha and Ao Bing's mortal bodies with the Seven-colored Precious Lotus. However, during the process of reconstruction, numerous obstacles arise. Together, they embark on a new journey to challenge their fate.

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播：辦「攻」秘笈: 他馬克老闆
programme.desc: Based on Taiwan's famous comic series “I'm Mark”, a fantasy comedy about crazy office life is going on the screen! Mark is a wage slave in advertising, working overtime every day. He is so desperate and tries to end this all, then the death god comes. But when the death god is ready to take Mark's life, it claims to leave work and let Mark survive for one more night. Mark grasps the last chance to vandalize the office to end his life without regret. But the following day, the death god finds he has mistaken the wrong target!? In other words, Mark still needs to stay in this mad world. However, Mark gets promoted into a special position and people in the office treat him as a VIP. What will happen when Mark become the boss.

programme.title: 葉問4完結篇
programme.desc: Ip Man's life remains unchanged after his wife's death, but he and his son are slowly drifting apart. To seek a better future for his son, Ip Man decides to travel to the U.S. only to find the stable, peaceful life abroad is only skin deep. Underneath lies a deep rooted racial discrimination that is far worse than he has expected. Ip Man re-examines his position and ponders on the reason he took up martial arts in the beginning.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 無間道
programme.desc: This is a story between the mole in the police department, Ming(Andy Lau) and the undercover cop, Yan(Tony Leung), who are competing to uncover each other first..

programme.title: 無間道 II
programme.desc: Forty-five years later, the man's sins come back to haunt his son, a professor specializing in sleeping disorders, when the lady's ghost returns for vengeance.

programme.title: 終極無間
programme.desc: Ten months after the murder of Yan (Tony Leung), Ming (Andy Lau) is relegated to the backseat of mundane office work, pending internal investigation. Exhausted mentally and physically, Ming is running on empty, but he is convinced that he can reverse his fortune in no time. Meanwhile, a new star has emerged in the police force. Hardly forty years old, Wing (Leon Lai) has already risen to the top echelon thanks to his illustrious track record..

programme.title: 初嚟報「導」 -簡君晋
programme.desc: 'In Broad Daylight', written and directed by emerging filmmaker Lawrence Kan, has garnered 16 nominations at the 42nd Hong Kong Film Awards. From the formative impact of films experienced in childhood to his adult pursuit of human connection through the lens of a camera, Lawrence's enduring curiosity about people has allowed him to witness the struggles of ordinary individuals-and, through a journey of being lost and learning to wait, to ultimately find his own voice. Let's follow this interview into Lawrence's inner world and listen to his pure passion and unwavering dedication to films.

programme.title: 聖誕玫瑰
programme.desc: Tim is a defence attorney with a heart of gold. Refusing to be simply a hired gun for his clients, he quits his high-powered job to become a prosecutor for the Justice Department. With the support of fiancee Megan and cop buddy Nam, Tim decides to start afresh. When he meets a handicapped piano teacher, Jing, who urges him to help her. She is accusing her doctor, Zhou a renowned surgeon of sexual harassment during a routine check-up. But with no witnesses and only their own conflicting testimonies, a Rashomon-like mystery unfolds. To make matters worse, Zhou's defence attorney, Freddy, is Tim's successor at his old law firm, and proves to be Tim's toughest opponent to-date. As a media frenzy encircles the case, it slowly destroys the lives of everyone involved.

programme.title: 我的麻煩老友
programme.desc: A-Gan is a mean and stingy but successful salesman. One day he has a car accident and meets his own conscious. His Conscious just gives him 7 days to live. A-Gan convinces it to let him live on if 7 people come and visit him. Disappointed by his colleagues' attitudes, A-Gan meets A-Tong, a girl who is as rude and mean as him. They finally change their bad personalities and A-Gan saves his own life by having 7 visitors.

programme.title: 三不管
programme.desc: In one of the darkest and diverse cultural part in the city, there is a minority group who lives in the place where it is full of despair and frustration. At first glance, their desperate living comprises illegal gambling, prostitution as well as drug-dealing. Indeed, their way of living is guided by their own norms and laws, regardless of the entrenched ones prevailing in the general public. Although their norms are chaotic and arbitrary, they do not violate the existence of the conventional ones. Consequently, it can be said that this chaotic region is unique within the city. On one occasion, there are two men, riding in a vehicle, unexpectedly enter this restricted region..

programme.title: 超能神探
programme.desc: One day, Hyun-joon, a policeman who lives with his mother and his daughter, attains a superpower after getting struck by the lightning. After the incident, Hyun-joon realizes that there are others who have been going through the same situation with him, and gets involved with unexpected situations. Will he be able to succeed both, as a father who struggles with the relationship with his daughter, and as a cop with a superpower who is eager to catch an evil criminal.

programme.title: 超越
programme.desc: Tianyi Wu, a young 100-meter-running champion, returns to his hometown, aiming to get off his chest the failure to surpass his former teammate, Chaoyue Hao. But he doesn't expect to see that Chaoyue's life is in shambles as well. They retreat to the memories of their lives, both shared and separate, in an attempt to lift each other up from their current situation.

programme.title: 失憶界刂女王
programme.desc: American Chinese Ding studies drama in Beijing. One day, she helps her friend chase after her boyfriend, running vigorously on a Beijing street where she bumps into Dong. The next day, Ding visits Dong, who, strangely enough, denies their acquaintance. Dong's buddy Dr Ching diagnoses his erratic behavior as the protection mechanism of human brain. The only way to lessen the pain is to erase or repress happy memories..

programme.title: 男航女機師
programme.desc: HAN Jung-woo, a pilot with top-class skills, is flying high and even appears on a famous TV show. But everything comes crashing down when a careless mistake causes him to lose everything, even his job. Blacklisted in the industry, no airline is willing to hire him. Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... Will his dream of cruising through life ever take off.

programme.title: 精武家庭
programme.desc: A mysterious person arrived in his wheelchair in Yue's Clinic and asked for a person called Tai Chi Lung. Later on, Yue was found disappeared, leaving behind his clinic a mess..

programme.title: 世外
programme.desc: Tasked to help transient souls through Another World to their reincarnation, the spirit GUDO meets a young girl called YURI, and embarks on a dangerous journey to help her overcome her anger and prevent her curse from destroying the world.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -跨越四徑挑戰
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.

programme.title: 「競」盡全力: 香港四徑大步走
programme.desc: At the time, they said it couldn't be done. In 2012, Andre Blumberg set off by himself, to run all four of Hong Kong's iconic ultra distance trails in just four days. 298km and over 14,500m of climbing later, one of the hardest ultra marathons in the world - the Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge - was born. With the 2021 edition of the challenge as the backdrop, 'Four Trails' takes you on a journey from when the concept was first was conceived to it's current format. Under 60 hours to be deemed a 'Finisher' and under 72 hours to be a ‘Survivor', unsupported and with an ever evolving set of rules. It takes a deep dive into the famous four trails that make up the challenge and you will both laugh and cry as the astonishing stories of those who dare attempt such a feat unfold.

programme.title: 金雞2
programme.desc: Set in the year 2046, 82-year-old Golden Chicken Ah Gum spots a heartbroken man planning to take memory loss-pills. She begins to recap her life story starting in 2003.

programme.title: 北齋：浮世繪傳奇
programme.desc: In the Edo-era, young impecunious artist Katsushika Hokusai lived in downtown Edo. He was shabby and lived from hand to mouth with little money he earned by selling his painting on the streets. But Tsutaya Juzaburo, the one of a kind publisher, discovered Hokusai's hidden talent and led him to unleash his potentials. With Juzaburo's help, Hokusai found the essence of drawing and his talent bloomed. Meanwhile, the entertainment ban came in effect by the Edo shogunate. While Hokusai became older, he built a strong relationship with Ryutei Tanehiko, the popular playwright, who was born as a samurai and was distressed in creating new plays because of the prohibition. Eventually Tanehiko got executed by the shogunate. Hokusai came out with all his repulsion against the Edo shogunate on his vivid drawings.

programme.title: 鬼們之蝴蝶大廈
programme.desc: A young mother and her child move into Room 606 of the infamous Butterfly Mansion, a notorious haunted building in the heart of Taipei. From the moment they arrive, eerie paranormal events begin to unfold, pushing her to uncover the dark secrets lurking within its walls. Amid the chaos, the building's new janitor-a kind and seemingly helpful young man-offers his support. But behind his warm smile lies a mystery of his own. As their paths intertwine, she realizes that everyone carries their own shadows, and the deeper she digs, the closer she gets to a chilling revelation. In Butterfly Mansion, the greatest lesson she learns is this: Humans Are More Terrifying Than Ghosts.

programme.title: 武俠
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi lives a seemingly normal life in a remote village. But his peaceful life is soon to be disrupted when a determined detective digs up his past.

programme.title: 快樂到死
programme.desc: Bora Choi, who works at an English language institute, is having an affair with her ex-lover, Il-Beom Kim. Her husband, Min-ki Seo, is a former banker. He has lost his job, and has taken over the domestic roles of the house: cooking, cleaning, and watching the baby. In his free time, he watches soap operas and reads romance novels. Min-ki is aware of the affair, but seems willing to put up with it and to continue living with his cheating wife. Bora is disturbed when Il-Beom seems to want to take their affair further and pushes past her boundaries, risking to expose their relationship.

programme.title: 武替道
programme.desc: LEE Sam was the undisputed king of stunt choreography during the golden era of Hong Kong action cinema in the 80s. After a devastating stunt accident, Sam steps away from the industry for 30 years. However, his old friend, a veteran director, has now persuaded Sam to work as the stunt choreographer on what will be the director's last film. The only catch is that his film stars Wai - Sam's former stunt crew member who has since become a famous action star in his own right. Sam and Wai have a contentious history, with Sam's infamously overbearing and demanding personality clashing with Wai's own ego and ambition. By chance, Sam crosses paths with a young, ambitious stuntman named LEE Sai Long, who sees this as an opportunity to advance his career. Long is caught between Sam and his former protege turned rival. At the same time, Long helps Sam to reconcile with his estranged daughter, Cherry. As Sam returns to the world he once dominated, he must confront his past, mend fences w.

programme.title: 非常幸運
programme.desc: Going nowhere in love and stuck in life as a lowly travel agent, Sophie finds escape in her own comic book creations. When she was winning the office contest for a prize trip to Singapore suddenly turns her life upside in the best way possible, as she meets there the man of her dreams: David, the handsome super-spy from her own comics. Before she can even get pack her luggage together, off they jump from the Marina Bay Sands Skydeck, and the chase is on for a lip-shaped key to the billion-dollar diamond called “Lucky Star Diamond”, a diamond capable of destroying the world, one country at a time.

programme.title: 年少日記
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng looks back to his repressed childhood memories, as he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. He strives hard to prevent another tragedy from happening, meanwhile facing a series of family problems, his wife is divorcing him, and his father is dying.

programme.title: 千萬別開門
programme.desc: ‘Soo-hyun' buys a used washing machine online after moving into her new place. When she receives a broken machine, she realizes she's been scammed and decides to make sure the seller doesn't get away with it! Eventually, Soo-hyun succeeds in finding the seller's online account, then leaves warnings that he is a fraudster under all his posts to stop him from selling. From then on, terrifying things start to happen to Soo-hyun. She led on ordinary life with an ordinary job, but everything in her daily life begins to fall apart, and an investigation to find the seller unfolds. Later, Soo-hyun goes to the seller's pace with Detective Joo, and discovers a dead body..

programme.title: 芳香之城傳奇
programme.desc: Princess Su of the magical Aroma City falls to earth and in love with Jiang. But as Jiang is no angel, there is an infernal contract out on his soul..

programme.title: 絕世好賓
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: 東極島
programme.desc: DONG JI ISLAND follows the tragic tale of a Japanese warship secretly transporting British prisoners of war and mistakenly attacked near the easternmost waters of China. To rescue the desperately trapped prisoners, a group of courageous islanders embark on a perilous journey against all odds to the sinking ship, facing relentless Japanese soldiers and the harsh, unforgiving seas..

programme.title: 「競」盡全力: 柔道龍虎榜
programme.desc: Pub Manager / band leader Sze-to was once the greatest Jodo fighter around until he unexpectedly gave up the sport for no apparent reason. nowadays Sze-to lives the life of an alcoholic gambler with no hope for the future, until cocky Judo enthusiast Tony shows up at the door and challenges Sze-to into a duet, Old Foe Kong demands finishing the match that never took place years ago; Sze-to mentor Master Cheng asks him to manage his rundown Dojo... All of a sudden, Sze-to's pub turns into an arena where the greatest Judo fighters show off their skills.... Sze-to will take on his opponents with everything he's got.

programme.title: 至尊三十六計之偷天換日
programme.desc: Mindy is a top-notched gambler. During a card game, Mindy swindle millions of dollars, but they are caught. Lau makes a deal with Mindy that Mindy needs to go to prison..

programme.title: 小生夢驚魂
programme.desc: Miao and his good friend Halley are roommates. One day, they run into a robbery and get involved in a traffic accident. Halley suffers slight injuries but Miao is dead for all purposes except his brain wave is still active. However, when Halley cries over his 'corpse', Miao bursts into explosive life. Then, Miao takes part in a brain wave experiment that drastically changes his life...Meanwhile, Halley is targeted for revenge after identifying the robbers..

programme.title: 暗戰2
programme.desc: The mysterious figure Ken confronts Sang in a hostage situation and challenges him into a game of ransom. Sang is intrigued..

programme.title: 摩登如來神掌
programme.desc: Two men fall journey into the far-reaches of China, but stumble upon a cave where Princess Wendy, her handmaid Mandy, and evil Tin have been in suspended animation for 800 years..

programme.title: 賭俠2之上海灘賭聖
programme.desc: Coming back learning from the God of Gambler, Star accidentally falls into a time tunnel and back to Shanghai in 1937, where he meets his grandfather Fook, Yvonne and Danny..

programme.title: 你OK，我OK
programme.desc: Twenty-five year old Liang Shao Chiang leads a boring life working as an auditor in a big finance corporation. He only has eyes for the receptionist Chow Yun-Lan. Chow is young and pretty, and is the natural target for the bunch of horny men around her. But she is pert and secretive, and no one is able to get even a date from her. Liang has fallen deeper and deeper for Chow. Alas this love is not reciprocative. But suddenly there is a breakthrough in his career, for four managers of the company is recommending a promotion for him! Of course, there is a price behind this - Liang has to let them use his bachelor apartment for conducting love affairs! Soon this scandal travels to the ears of the general manager Mr. Lui..

programme.title: 生死決
programme.desc: The best swordsmen of China and Japan have made it a historical ritual to meet every 10 years for a showdown of fighting skills and powers. The leading fighter of the Japanese ninjas, Hashimoto, and the Chinese chief Ching Wan have come to respect each other after they met, but tradition demands that they lock swords. Their honor is put to the test when rogue ninjas barge into the battlefield..

programme.title: 笑「星」滿中秋: 八星報喜
programme.desc: Fai, the eldest, has met Fong. Long is a guy with many girl-friends. A girl working in a deparment store has become his target. Sung, is a timid artist. Ying comes into his life..

programme.title: 火燒紅蓮寺
programme.desc: Rumors have it that the Shaolin Temple is harbouring revolutionaries. The emperor believes the rumors and decides to wipe out the temple. Fong Sai-yuk escapes with his uncle to the desert. There they run into Tou Tou. Yuk's uncle is killed by the king's general, and Tou and Yuk are captured. They are taken to the Red Lotus Temple; the temple is run by Elder Kung. Hung Hei Koon, has already joined Elder Kung and voluntarily becomes his protege. Yuk looks for every chance to escape but is stopped by Koon and Koon is just pretending to have joined Elder Kung. With Koon's help, Yuk finally defeats Elder Kung..

Smash-head is a CID officer. Wracked by insecurity he believes the world will be destroyed by pollution. That's why he's an environmentalist. Carmen is a child psychologist. She specializes in hypnotism, her world is full of grace and vitality. That's why she believes in love. The two meet during a police chase. When Smash-head kills a hostage he mistakes as a kidnapper, he is put under internal investigation. And his superior tries to drag him into a corrupt syndicate. With no way out, he turns to Carmen. Under hypnotism, he remembers his long forgotten past and the image he had of himself as a young and enthusiastic fighter for justice. Holding on to this memory and the love of Carmen, he takes his pistol, number 9413..

programme.title: 暗戰2
programme.desc: The mysterious figure Ken confronts Sang in a hostage situation and challenges him into a game of ransom. Sang is intrigued..

programme.title: 影人映語 -洪家班靠「搏」出位 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: In the last episode, Sammo Hung shared his story of being an action-choreographer, director and actor for over half a century in the film industry. Now he is going to talk more about apprenticeship with his master Yu Jim-yuen whom he learned the martial arts philosophy from and his journey of growing next-generation action stars; also give us an insight into the challenges towards Hong Kong action film nowadays.

programme.title: 人嚇人
programme.desc: Fatboy is a helper to Grand Uncle who is the town's high priest. They are now found in the ancestral shrine of the Mas working wonders. Fatboy is also being reprimanded by Grand Uncle for being rude to his fiancee, Yuen. The last of the Mas, the rich family in town, is back but Ma Lucho is coming home dead. Accompanying the body is a woman who claims to be Ma's wife and very much pregnant. But Fatboy knows his boyhood friend Ma couldn't be a husband because he was impotent..

programme.title: 你OK，我OK
programme.desc: Twenty-five year old Liang Shao Chiang leads a boring life working as an auditor in a big finance corporation. He only has eyes for the receptionist Chow Yun-Lan. Chow is young and pretty, and is the natural target for the bunch of horny men around her. But she is pert and secretive, and no one is able to get even a date from her. Liang has fallen deeper and deeper for Chow. Alas this love is not reciprocative. But suddenly there is a breakthrough in his career, for four managers of the company is recommending a promotion for him! Of course, there is a price behind this - Liang has to let them use his bachelor apartment for conducting love affairs! Soon this scandal travels to the ears of the general manager Mr. Lui..

programme.title: 嫁個有錢人
programme.desc: ME is embarked on her adventure to Europe to seek a wealthy husband, and she runs into ravishing DAN. Can she find true happiness and her glass high-heeled shoes as Cinderella did.

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 生死決
programme.desc: The best swordsmen of China and Japan have made it a historical ritual to meet every 10 years for a showdown of fighting skills and powers. The leading fighter of the Japanese ninjas, Hashimoto, and the Chinese chief Ching Wan have come to respect each other after they met, but tradition demands that they lock swords. Their honor is put to the test when rogue ninjas barge into the battlefield..

programme.title: 八星報喜
programme.desc: Fai, the eldest, has met Fong. Long is a guy with many girl-friends. A girl working in a deparment store has become his target. Sung, is a timid artist. Ying comes into his life..

programme.title: 重案組
programme.desc: Eddie Chan, a guilt-ridden cop trying to silence his demons from a recent shoot-out who is assigned to rescue kidnapped businessman Huang Yifei. It is a trail that leads Chan and his partner, Hung from Hong Kong to Taipei and back to Hong Kong. As the trail gets warmer, Chan begins to suspect that there are internal forces – including Hung – who seem to working against him..

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: A member of the Flying Tiger Squad, Sing, is sent to school as an undercover cop to find the Commissioner's lost gun. To Sing, school is nowhere better than jail. He is suffering until he comes across the school teacher Miss Ho. Sing's school life is thus painted with more colours. Finally, Sing settles every problem and succeeds in finding the lost gun. At the Same Time, he destorys a munition smuggling activity. This leads the smugglers to school to take revenge. A group of students is being kept hostage. Sing shows his true colour by saving all the students. This not only wins his students' admiration but also Miss Ho's heart.

programme.title: 四人新世界
programme.desc: Fei is the master cook in Hong Kong, while his son Suckling has established himself as a real estate salesman in Canada. Suckling sends for his father to join him in this new chapter of their lives. Happily, Fei hops on a plane to Canada. During the flight, he has the good fortune of meeting Yim Chau, a young woman traveling to join her aunt in Canada. Subsequently, Fei meets Yim Chau's aunt and Suckling meets Yim Chau. Suckling loves Yim Chau but is too shy to express his feelings. When Yim Chau announces she falls in love with Richard, Suckling feels heartbroken but still helps her with dating preparations. However, when he discovers Richard cheating her, Suckling fights him. At the same time, he is being chased by the bank for debts..

programme.title: 蠍子戰士
programme.desc: Fei comes to Hong Kong with his son Yushu and winds up a back-alley barber. Yushu is now in high school but he only likes to draw pictures. He also is hot blooded, thus often getting into fights. By accident, Yushu meets beautiful Ru. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..

programme.title: 最佳損友
programme.desc: After the death of their father, Kwai was asked to take over half of his father's properties but Fu was not willing to share. Fu then sent three pals to ruin Kwai's reputation..

programme.title: 笑「星」滿中秋: 最佳損友闖情關
programme.desc: Kwai's brother owed the Fok's family two million and Fok's manager Robert persuaded to merge Fu's company. The three pals joined Fok's to solve the crisis..

programme.title: 薰衣草
programme.desc: Athena is an aromatherapy tutor but can't heal up her wound at heart. One day, she finds a broken-wing angel falling on balcony. A scented romance is gradually in between them..

programme.title: 風雲雄霸天下
programme.desc: Nie Feng (Wind) and Bu Jingyun (Cloud) are raised by Xiong Ba of World Society, helping him to conquer the world. But Xiong Ba is their mutual enemy who killed their fathers..

programme.title: 整蠱專家
programme.desc: Jing Koo, is hired by Kam to get rid of Chi, to be the manager of the company. But he finds himself being cheated. He regains his confidence and competes with the 'King of Tricks'..

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: This is the story of four aspiring young men striving to fight for their own goals. Kui and his family are intent upon emigrating to another country and they put all their energy in making as much money as possible in order to leave Hong Kong sooner. However just as their goal is about in sight, over-exertion causes Kui to fall ill...Keung is a smart and aggressive young man whose ambition is to make it in the world. But misfortune descends upon him when discovering that he and his family are duped by his boss...It has been a childhood dream of Chung to join the police force but his fragile frame of a body is far from satisfactory, so he turns to conducting traffic and handing out tickets to unfortunate drivers amid the bustles of the streets. programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by Taiwan's underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. programme.desc: As soon as Tony Leung, starts imitating the stilted dialogue of 60s heartthrob Lui Kei, film lovers know they've entered a circle of movie-in-jokes and self-conscious world.

programme.desc: Buck trails two suspicious men and jumps into action to foil their plans. Soon after he meets Liu, who convinces Buck that he may be the long-lost son of a rich korean businessman..

programme.desc: As a Philippine freighter moors in Hong Kong, Gary, a man on board, assaults a Customs Officer during a routine inspection and escapes ashore. Acting on a tip-off that Gary is hiding in a prostitute's home, Yeung tries to trap him, but the polices also arrest the Captain's brother, John..

programme.title: 笑「星」滿中秋: 家有囍事
programme.desc: All's Well, Ends Well is a comic romance of 3 hapless brothers, who eventually learn through their amorous exploits and misadventures that love is only won through gradual nurturing, and quickly lost through the quick, dishonest, selfish ways which they have always taken for granted.

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: Lang Kim Sang, a famous Cantonese Opera actress, strives to revitalize the traditional art. She hires a new director but stirs up resentment and jealousy within the troupe..

programme.title: 發達先生

programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: 伊波拉病毒
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Kai, a local gangster was caught in bed with his boss's wife, he killed both the boss and his wife. The boss's daughter Lily witnessed the murders and managed to escape afterwards. As the police were looking for him, Kai was forced to disappear... For the last ten years, Kai has worked in a Chinese restaurant in Johannesburg in South Africa after being smuggled into the country. The restaurant owner Brother Kei and his wife Ling take advantage of Kai's situation and treat him badly. One day Kai goes to buy meat from a native tribe, he is unaware of that a terrible epidemic – the Ebola virus has broken out among the tribesmen. During the trip Kai rapes and murders a black girl who is infected with the disease. Kai has no idea he is carrying the disease, his body creates an antibody which means he is a carrier but the disease won't affect him..

programme.title: 靈幻先生
programme.desc: One dark night, a charlatan Uncle Ming attempts to exorcise angry spirits in a haunted house but is unsuccessful and he narrowly escapes. He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神
programme.desc: At the first God of Gamblering contest, Ko Chun is told to lose the contest as his master's interests in betting the champion. Ko refuses and is shot by his enraged master..

programme.title: 夏日的麼麼茶
programme.desc: Summer flies to an island to sell a resort that is invested by her and her cousin. She meets Momocha who claims to be the authentic owner of the hotel. They begin a battle of love..

programme.title: 影人映語 -鐵骨闖江湖 - 錢小豪
programme.desc: Being a well-known martial art movie star, Chin Siu Ho talks about his stories and personal feelings from such long journey. When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode.

programme.desc: Yuen Biao and Yuen Wah are two Ming Dynasty adversaries who topple into an ice chasm, only to be thawed out in modern day Hong Kong.

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 魔翡翠
programme.desc: Archaeologist Shum finds an antique jade with supernatural power in Greece. The stone is wanted both by KGB's agent Karoff and the Interpol. Shum asks his friend Nike (Andy Lau) for help. However, Shum is finally caught by KGB but the jade is slipped into the hands of a boy called Pan. He discovers the crystal is from space and they become friends. While Nike is imputed and jailed, Karoff comes and captures Pan to get the jade.....

programme.title: 奸人本色
programme.desc: Leung Piu a swindler, cheats Yue Nan out of his life savings. This leads to Yue Nan's death, leaving his daughter Winnie behind. The Kang family, long disgusted by Leung's treachery, vow to avenge Yue Nan. They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family..

programme.title: 星願
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.

programme.desc: Fat is a neglected member of 'The King's Guardian'. Kam dynasty uses an excuse to assassinate the Emperor. Fat smells the trouble and goes along secretly to protect the Emperor..

programme.title: 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.

programme.title: 一蚊雞保鑣
programme.desc: Bon Bon, a resident of Tuen Mun, who's always attempting to implement his latest pyramid scheme. Bon Bon rescues a lady from a lecher occasionally and decides to implement his latest scheme, 'One Dollar Bodyguard'. He'll protect women on their evening strolls for one HK dollar. Bon Bon has to attend to his own problem, which is his inability to ride in a moving vehicle, that strands him in Tuen Mun for life. And there's the romantic issue with Snooker to resolve..

The Priest shepherds a group of corpses home. He has to fight off some vicious devils. The Priest's classmate has been assigned the job of accompanying the coffin of a prince back to the capital. One night, a thunderbolt rips the coffin and the prince becomes a vampire. He kills many people. The Priest asks to help. He finds his classmate has killed himself..

Tong is shaken at Chau's beauty. He decides to go after her. But Chau's master Mrs. Wah is very angry with Tong's family, how can Tong make Chau Heung his bride.

programme.desc: In the year 2043, the notorious villain is about to be put on trial. His killers decide to go back 50 years by the time tunnel, and look for the judge in his youthful age..

programme.title: 江湖情
programme.desc: Yung was caught red-handed in making a mischief. He and his friend Ying Hung decided to rob Chu Lo Tai. However, the attempt of robbery was unsuccessful and they were pursued..

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: Lee Ah Chai, a native Chiu Chow, a province of China. He was married with children of his own. He was rich, powerful and influential and he was the leading man in the underworld, virtually to as the ‘Big Boss'. But he was unhappy. After spending so many years involving with vice and crime, he was sick of this world and wanted to start his life anew. Some ten years ago, Chai had two side-kicks, Tang Kar Yung and Chan Ting Kok. Kok was adopted by Uncle Cut, the father of Yung. The two boys were raised up together and they were like brothers, if not by blood. But a misconception broke out which overshadowed the relationship amongst the three of them. It led Chai and Yung to divergence and the fight of Kok to Malacca..

programme.title: 鐵妹
programme.desc: The Story is set in the period during the Japanese invasion of China in the 1930's. A Chinese traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.

programme.desc: The word is out: underworld kingpin Jimmy Yam will be killed in a day. He has a chance to see who the people around him really are and finds out who is behind the assassination..

programme.title: 少林門
programme.desc: The Shaolin Temple is the center of Chinese martial arts and the cradle of anti-Manchu patriots in the 17th century. However, a Shaolin renegade Shih has defected to the Manchu and is leading a suppression of patriots trying to overthrow the Qing Dynasty. Tan Hsiung, a patriot, is arrested and killed by Shih. The Shaolin Abbot thus calls on his best student, Yun Fei to stop Shih from killing more people. Yun happens to find help from another anti-Manchu patriot, Tan, who is actually Tan Hsiung's younger brother. Along with help of Zorro, a master swordsman..

programme.title: A計劃
programme.desc: This is Hong Kong at the turn of the century. The South China Sea is crawling with smugglers, cut-throats and pirates and none is more successful than the gang led by the notorious pirate Lo. Government forces invariably lose to Lo. Finally the Government looks the other way whenever Lo is around. Young seaman Jackie Chan, so far better known for his bar room fights, resigns from the Marine Force. He plans to stage a personal vendetta against Lo. Jackie gets the help of Samo Hung, little knowing Samo has his own axe to grind. Jackie and Samo suffer an inglorious drubbing in the hands of Lo. Jackie, now completely incensed, decides to don the uniform once again. He finds young commander Yuen Biao sympathetic to his cause but adamant against his antics..

programme.title: A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of Chinese revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace..

programme.title: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: At the foothills of Fingers Mountain, there is one Highwaymen's Haven, operating as a motel. The gang leader is a fellow named The Joker, and the gang makes a living out of robbing the traveling businessmen and scholars. The Joker is in fact Monkey King reincarnated. Grandpa Buddha is the only God who knows about this. Two of the devils, Spider Woman and Boney M, took the guise of Sharon Stone and Madonna and wooed him into betraying this secret. The two devils decided to get the Joker out of the way so that they could capture the Longevity Monk when the time came for his reincarnation..

programme.title: 西遊記之仙履奇緣
programme.desc: The Joker travels back in time to save his beloved, the reformed devil Boney M. But instead of the right place and right time, he finds himself stranded in five hundred years back..

programme.title: 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 百年好合
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May. The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost 'Heartbreak Sword Technique'..

programme.title: 笑「星」滿中秋: 豪門夜宴
programme.desc: “The Banquet” assembled star-studded cast that aimed for charity to support disaster relief efforts at that time. Adapted from the 1959 Cantonese film of the same name and co-directed by Tsui Hark, Clifton Ko, Joe Cheung, and Alfred Cheung, the film tells the story of a greedy couple deceiving their estranged father to secure a huge amount business deal with oil producing country. While they pretend to welcome the father into their home and prepare a birthday banquet for him, rival also throws a competing banquet...With continuous top-star cameos offering countless surprises and laughs, this film remains remarkable, entertaining and meaningful to audience nowadays.

programme.desc: Five years have passed since the events of the first God of Gamblers film. Ko Chun is now living a peaceful retirement on his French estate with his pregnant wife Wan Yau, while his disciples Knife and Sing have become world-renowned in their own right. Chun declines repeated challenges from other top-ranked gamblers, having given up gambling in favor of the quiet life. Chun's friend and former bodyguard, Lung Wu, the 'God Of Guns', comes to pay him a visit. While the two are away from the house for a friendly shooting competition, Chau Siu-Chee, a Taiwanese gambler and the world's number one contender to Ko Chun's title, arrives and murders his wife and unborn son in order to goad Chun into a gambling match. After a shootout with Chau Siu-Chee's henchmen, Ko Chun arrives to discover his wife dying. With her last breath, she asks Chun to promise that he will not gamble or admit his real identity for one year, in the hopes that he will not lose his life in an impulsive act of.

programme.title: 夜瘋狂

With two more accomplices, the four girls decide to destroy the body and split the $40 million the man has on him. But his gangs catch up with the girls and are about to rape and then kill them..

As the police assign a tough, gutsy inspector Cindy to stop Ha's vigilante hunting out of court, another murder brings them together in the search for the real killer, who may or may not be one of their own.

programme.title: 一哥
programme.desc: Scriptwriter See is a confirmed bachelor. Wai is his devoted butler. Next door is no-good police Ko and his complaining wife Kit. Kit is beautiful and vain. See takes Ko to a macho convention chaired by young and handsome Kar. See gets the highest prize, a beautiful slave girl. She immediately turns the See household upside down. See wants to escape. Ko learns Kit's romance with Kar. He asks See for help. But Kar defeats their every move..

programme.title: 太子爺出差
programme.desc: Te-pei sets up an Angel's Dust scan but finds himself trapped by Hong Kong police led by Chang. They are ordered to cooperate to crack the narcotize ring and suspect rich Chen as the kingpin. This leads to a Yunan martial arts troupe. Chang falls in love with the troupe's star, Hung. Police raid the troupe but find nothing as Hung has unwittingly taken the narcotics. She wants to smuggle herself to America, only to find herself chased by police and traffickers..

programme.title: 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened..

His girlfriend, Annie, is oblivious to the fact that her former incarnation was the village girl who perished the General to eternal suffering. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General..

programme.title: 鬼馬雙星

Once they get out of jail they team up to make fortune. The two gamblers try their hands at several profitable projects. One day, Liu hits upon a grand plan, but it needs a lot of capital. Therefore he decides to participate in a TV contest so as to win the money..

programme.title: 殭屍家族
programme.desc: Antique dealer Kwok roams the countryside with his two assistants searching for rare objects. One day they fall into the cellar of a shrine. There they find three vampires, all rendered harmless by talismans. Kwok takes Sonny Vampire to town, but when the talisman is removed accidentally, the vampire escapes and is being hidden by 6-year-old Chia Chia then. Papa Vampire and Mama Vampire are awakened too when the talismans fall off. Dr. Lin and reporter Ha decide to help stop the vampires from killing people..

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之西域雄獅
programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 至尊計狀元才
programme.desc: As a prominent gambler, Ray has encountered many challenges in his career. When Chiang challenges Ray to a gambling contest with him in Macau, Ray's adventures begin again..

programme.title: 皇家戰士
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.title: 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened..

programme.title: 想飛
programme.desc: When Joker meets Ling in a disco one night, he feels she is the perfect model of his dream project 'princess-d'. In reality, however, Ling is the opposite of the perfect image..

programme.title: 太子爺出差
programme.desc: Te-pei sets up an Angel's Dust scan but finds himself trapped by Hong Kong police led by Chang. They are ordered to cooperate to crack the narcotize ring and suspect rich Chen as the kingpin. This leads to a Yunan martial arts troupe. Chang falls in love with the troupe's star, Hung. Police raid the troupe but find nothing as Hung has unwittingly taken the narcotics. She wants to smuggle herself to America, only to find herself chased by police and traffickers..

programme.title: 鬼馬雙星
programme.desc: Teng is the No. 1 con man plus professional gambler in jail. During the jail time, he meets young Liu and the two become friends. Once they get out of jail they team up to make fortune. The two gamblers try their hands at several profitable projects. One day, Liu hits upon a grand plan, but it needs a lot of capital. Therefore he decides to participate in a TV contest so as to win the money..

programme.title: 小親親
programme.desc: Zhang hosts a top radio program that offers advice regarding love affairs. He starts a love-war relationship with Wu, a columnist, when she hears him gossiping on her love life.

programme.title: 代客泊車
programme.desc: Stanley was an optimistic youth, feeling bored in his pig-rearing job, he decided to part with his beloved uncle and aunt and seek for an ideal job to achieve his own goal in life. He then found a job in Tsim Sha Tsui East. There he worked as a member of a parking service team and befriended one of his colleagues Ah Man. Ah Man was a reticent guy who was always frustrated by reality. The problem that he could not afford his sister to further studies in oversea puzzled him now and then. His anxiety was intensified by his sorrowful devotion to a mysterious beautiful girl Stella. Stanley was enthusiastic to help Ah Man to be acquainted with Stella. This made Ah Man live in high spirits. Stanley also encouraged his colleagues to work with enthusiasm. Their team was therefore rewarded with more tips by customers. A member of another team was a man of misconduct who stole spare parts and valuables from customer's cars. Mr. Yang, was a man who made fake banknotes..

programme.title: 西環的故事
programme.desc: The rough and tough Kennedy Town. And three young men, Chiang, Peng and Wei, came to the scene. Chiang and Wei help Peng to become a policeman. Chiang and Wei also provide the information which enables Peng to crack a few cases. Then Chiang and Wei kill a gangster by accident. Chiang decides to surrender himself to Peng and jail. Peng, however, takes over Chiang's girlfriend. Chiang comes out from jail, Peng plots to get rid of all gangland chief, Chiang and Wei inclusive..

programme.title: 玻璃樽
programme.desc: C.N. faces his greatest challenge when he meets young country girl Bu and falls in love! But when Howie sets a trap for him, C.N. must prepare to fight for his lady and his life.

programme.title: 誤人子弟
programme.desc: Lam's childhood desire was to become a teacher. After graduating from university, he actually fulfilled his dream and found himself “STAND & DELIVER”, becoming a teacher. When Lam started teaching, he was full of hope and enthusiasm. After three years of experience in the industry, he gradually become stale about his job like the other teachers..

programme.title: 不死情謎
programme.desc: Sam and his team are members of a Serious Crime Unit in the District Crime Squad, conducting a crackdown on an international crime organization trafficking in the human cargo of illegal immigrants. The team successfully dissolves the group and destroys its power in Southeast Asia. They arrest one of the group's leaders, Night. At the court, Night is charged with several offences and is being prosecuted by Sam's fiancee, Ann. Ann tries her best to convict Night for all the crimes he committed. However, the defense lawyer is tough and manipulative and finally, Night is convicted on only one of the charges in human smuggling and sentenced to three years imprisonment. Night is unrepentant and vows to take his revenge and destroy the couple one day. During the lawyer's visit, Night relays this message to his brother, Day, and asks Day to carry out the revenge for him..

programme.title: 太子傳說
programme.desc: Cheung is Prince, the son of crime boss Mr. Pak in the underworld. He kills flamboyantly with the help of partner Ching Ching, who was a gift from Mr. Pak many years ago. Still, despite Ching's constant companionship, Prince longs for a woman he has seen in his dreams since youth. The dream girl is a dancer Tweedy. He also longs to kill Drago, who was supposedly responsible for taking his mother away. Dragon actually has his own vendetta against Pak, as Pak kidnapped his son many years ago. The missing son turns up, and he's now a killer who goes by the name of Prince.

programme.title: 特警新人類
programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'..

programme.title: 萬象「芳」華: 祝您好運
programme.desc: Mr. and Mrs. Cao had an heirloom, a valuable diamond named “LUCKY STAR”. They insured the diamond for a large sum of money then hired four gangsters to rob it in order to cheat the insurance company for the compensation. However, when the gangsters got the diamond, one of them intended to possess the diamond alone but was discovered by the others. They were very angry and wanted to kill him. He escaped into Zhi's house and put the diamond into the facial cream of Zhi and then quitted. Unluckily, Zhi was mistaken by the other three that she was his member and helped to receive the loot. So Zhi was involved in the case and was attacked by the three gangsters but fortunately she could escape with her tricks..

programme.title: 林世榮
programme.desc: Lam sai-wing is the mischievous student of Wong Fei-hung. His eagerness to help others often lands himself in some precarious situations. programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季
programme.desc: While the Malibu fires rage towards Darin’s home, he and Zac are deep in the jungle and off the grid uncovering the mysteries of the most powerful and potent plants in the Amazon Rainforest.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In South Korea, Rooftop and Catfish take on some daring (and borderline stupid) activities. They become the first BMX bikers to every ride at the North Korean/South Korean boarder, scale Korea’s skyscrapers, become sword-smiths, and train in the ancient art of tae kwon do. But the fun doesn’t stop there. The duo find themselves in the center of a mud festival and trying out the tightrope art of jultagi all before testing the strength of their stomachs with some live octopus. With South Korea being the last stop of the season, it looks like Rooftop and Catfish are going to need a long nap back in America.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take you around the world for a look at never-before-seen shenanigans of the BMX duo, and you won’t believe some of the activities that didn’t make the previous episodes. Rooftop and Catfish hatch crocodiles, get maced in a gas chamber, attempt to grow Catfish a few inches, race tuk tuk carts in Thailand, and so much more. They try out a Romanian banya sauna, ride a human run wooden Ferris wheel, try the explosive Columbian game tejo, and last but not least neuter a horse. Enjoy this action packed special of even crazier activities.

programme.title: Spiky Gold Hunters 第1季
programme.desc: In this episode of Spiky Gold Hunters, skipper Dwayne and the crew head to a consistent urchin dive spot. A keen young dingy boy, George, endures a baptism of fire as the team tries to fill a backlog of orders. With the demand turned up to maximum and a unique food festival to provide for, everyone on the boat is fighting for the top spot of bringing in the biggest amount of urchin.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In South Korea, Rooftop and Catfish take on some daring (and borderline stupid) activities. They become the first BMX bikers to every ride at the North Korean/South Korean boarder, scale Korea’s skyscrapers, become sword-smiths, and train in the ancient art of tae kwon do. But the fun doesn’t stop there. The duo find themselves in the center of a mud festival and trying out the tightrope art of jultagi all before testing the strength of their stomachs with some live octopus. With South Korea being the last stop of the season, it looks like Rooftop and Catfish are going to need a long nap back in America.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. 第1季
programme.desc: Ivan Carter exposes the secret war in Africa. A war of greed that’s putting the rhino in danger.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. 第2季
programme.desc: Ivan goes on a journey to save his friend's nineteen rhinos from the poaching epidemic now sweeping through South Africa. The solution: a logistical nightmare of transporting the entire herd to a secure location 600 miles across the country.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. 第2季
programme.desc: While visiting a secret orphanage that cares for rescued baby rhinos, Ivan discovers the blood, sweat, tears that goes into saving this endangered species. An emergency phone call sends him on an adventure with a group of local heroes to save the next newly orphaned rhino.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. \nWhat becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope.\nBack at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第2集 -Warwick - River Avon and War of Roses
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, beneath the majestic medieval Warwick Castle, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, explore the River Avon. In the first ever archeological river search in the castle’s thousand year history, they’ll seek 15th century treasures from the brutal medieval battles of the Wars of the Roses.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: A once sought-after pet, the green iguanas escaped their terrariums in the 60's and found the Florida eco-system to be a much more hospitable environment to call home. Free to roam the canals, parks, and suburban neighborhoods, these pets-gone-feral have exploded in both size and population, causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage a year in Florida. Urban hunter Michael Onega is doing his part to clean up the environment by removing as many iguanas as possible, limiting their population spread. The singular goal - to make sure the iguanas never establish a healthy breeding population in the Everglades. Yia joins Michael and his trusty Labrador Scout on Michael's mud boat, as they patrol the canals in Michael's backyard. The only thing better than Scout retrieving the fallen iguanas, are BBQed iguana and iguana tacos cooked up in Michael's backyard.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In South Korea, Rooftop and Catfish take on some daring (and borderline stupid) activities. They become the first BMX bikers to every ride at the North Korean/South Korean boarder, scale Korea’s skyscrapers, become sword-smiths, and train in the ancient art of tae kwon do. But the fun doesn’t stop there. The duo find themselves in the center of a mud festival and trying out the tightrope art of jultagi all before testing the strength of their stomachs with some live octopus. With South Korea being the last stop of the season, it looks like Rooftop and Catfish are going to need a long nap back in America.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季

香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《動畫的靈魂》. 動畫電影的一秒，承載着無數人的心血。. 本港動畫長片《世外》講述一個有關死後輪迴、放下執念的故事，製作歷時七年，由團隊一筆一劃手繪完成，最終獲得金像獎八項提名以及金馬獎最佳動畫長片，讓香港動畫再次被看見。然而就在此刻，AI浪潮席捲而至——過去需要漫長時間繪製的畫面，如今幾分鐘便能生成，動畫的製作模式正被改變。. 《世外》團隊堅持人手繪製，因為他們相信，唯有這樣才能畫出角色的溫度。擔任動畫美術總監的張小踏認為，風格源於人的不完美：「怎樣才有靈魂呢？就是人類加給它，人就是會有錯，會有奇怪的東西加進去，還有新的東西，暫時AI 是做不到。」而曾執導《麥兜故事》等多部動畫電影的導演袁建滔，卻看到AI的另一面。他視AI 為創作的輔助工具：「你降低了成本，大家便有機會試不同的東西，你多嘗試就會進步，不試甚麼都沒有。」. 兩種選擇，沒有對錯。本片紀錄了三位動畫製作人袁建滔、張小踏、何歷對動畫的熱情與面對AI浪潮時的掙扎。他們如何在成本與創作之間取捨？如何在科技浪潮下守住動畫的靈魂.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群 第二季
programme.sub-title: 第一集：開學前的「回家大戲」
programme.desc: 劉向上一家假期結束前南下度假。怎料颱風入境，航班被迫取消。無奈之下，他們開始了一場「回家征途」，最終在半夜，劉向上和戴靜才帶着兩個小孩疲憊地回到家。另一邊廂，景婷婷懷孕反應明顯，胎兒更是有發育遲緩的風險.

programme.title: 消失的兇手
programme.sub-title: 第十七集: 聶寶華、聶小雨受襲擊
programme.desc: 迷茫中的衛國平去找當日培育他的陳山河父親，陳父鼓勵他要為犧牲了的人而活得更好。衛國平收到一條訊息說有人要對付姓聶的。聶寶華在半路遭到埋伏，趙剛帶人要來殺他。而另一邊，聶寶華的情婦寶麗帶人突然襲擊了聶小雨，聶小雨駕車逃跑時落入水中，跟著汽車沉入水底.

programme.title: 太平年
programme.desc: 錢弘俶對溫州知州歐陽寬的说辭深表懷疑並暗中調查，發現本應運往前線的軍糧被秘密藏匿於博易務下屬的山越社棧倉之內。為獲鐵證，錢弘俶借調水師突擊搜查起獲大量糧食，徹底揭露了歐陽寬勾結山越社程昭悅貪污軍糧的罪行，歐陽寬等人終被依法嚴懲。錢弘俶以雷霆手段處決歐陽寬震懾官吏，迅速籌糧緩解前線危機，並任命崔仁冀接任溫州知州。然而其剛猛舉措在杭州朝堂引發爭議，錢弘佐為予支持，特命錢弘倧尋回能臣慎溫其聽候調遣以協助錢弘俶.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 生態捍衛戰
programme.sub-title: 生態捍衛戰 - 印尼篇 The Last Defenders of Indonesia
programme.desc: 印尼的勒塞爾生態系統，是地球上最後一個同時住了野生老虎、大象、猩猩和犀牛的地方。但這裏卻成為總值數以百萬元計的國際野生動物走私生意的中心，長期飽受非法狩獵活動的威脅。亨德拉．薩普特拉、達赫拉維和他們的護林員團隊，冒著性命危險深入遼闊的熱帶雨林巡邏，沿著線索追蹤偷獵位置、拆除陷阱。 The Leuser Ecosystem in Indonesia is the last place on earth with tigers, elephants, orangutans, and rhinos together in the wild. It is under a constant threat of poaching, that feeds a multimillion-dollar international wildlife trafficking industry. Hendra Saputra, Dahlawi, and their team of forest rangers patrol the rich expanse of the tropical rainforest, putting their lives at risk as they follow leads on possible poaching grounds and snares.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《動畫的靈魂》. 動畫電影的一秒，承載着無數人的心血。. 本港動畫長片《世外》講述一個有關死後輪迴、放下執念的故事，製作歷時七年，由團隊一筆一劃手繪完成，最終獲得金像獎八項提名以及金馬獎最佳動畫長片，讓香港動畫再次被看見。然而就在此刻，AI浪潮席捲而至——過去需要漫長時間繪製的畫面，如今幾分鐘便能生成，動畫的製作模式正被改變。. 《世外》團隊堅持人手繪製，因為他們相信，唯有這樣才能畫出角色的溫度。擔任動畫美術總監的張小踏認為，風格源於人的不完美：「怎樣才有靈魂呢？就是人類加給它，人就是會有錯，會有奇怪的東西加進去，還有新的東西，暫時AI 是做不到。」而曾執導《麥兜故事》等多部動畫電影的導演袁建滔，卻看到AI的另一面。他視AI 為創作的輔助工具：「你降低了成本，大家便有機會試不同的東西，你多嘗試就會進步，不試甚麼都沒有。」. 兩種選擇，沒有對錯。本片紀錄了三位動畫製作人袁建滔、張小踏、何歷對動畫的熱情與面對AI浪潮時的掙扎。他們如何在成本與創作之間取捨？如何在科技浪潮下守住動畫的靈魂.

programme.title: 好玩科學
programme.desc: 今集，小朋友將進行多項實驗，包括：利用聲波控制水流、探究震動幅度如何影響聲音音調、用鉛筆操控聚合物鏈、測試呵欠是否會傳染，以及透過干擾成核中心將水瞬間結冰。「未來科技」環節則會介紹利用聲波隔絕氧氣來滅火的「聲波滅火筒」，以及一套應用觸覺回饋技術的虛擬控制系統。. The kids take on experiments using sound waves to control the behaviour of a stream of water; how the size of vibrations affects the pitch of sound; how to use pencils to manipulate polymer strands; how yawns can be contagious and turning water into ice instantly via disrupted nucleation centres. Fun future facts check out a sound-based fire extinguisher that uses sound waves to disrupt the oxygen source of a fire, and a virtual control system based on haptic feedback.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 與派對口罩截然不同的是，尋古大師向我們展示了公元一世紀羅馬礦井工人用來保護肺部免受灰塵侵害的醫用口罩。在中世紀瘟疫期間，人們認為長喙口罩可以保護醫生免受「污濁空氣」的侵害。很久以後，醫用口罩被證明能夠有效抵抗疾病和病毒，例如新冠病毒……這對尋古大師來說是一段充滿風險的旅程.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師的手錶響了，他要跟特務頭領360開會。他客廳的牆滑開到另一邊，展現了神秘基地的存在，這裡開發了很多不同種類的膠水！但敵方特務阿減和阿勞想趁尋古大師向基層技術員介紹不同膠水的原理時嘗試綁架他。他是這方面的專家！特務尋古大師能夠成功擺脫兩個敵方特務嗎？他當然能夠，即使要用上世上最強力的膠水.

programme.title: 家·我心我城
programme.sub-title: 第七集：西決勸東霓不要打胎
programme.desc: 夜晚江薏家，西決夢到了二嬸。西決醒來見薏在旁，兩人關係明顯更進一步。學校裡，南音發現蘇遠智想要考的是廣州的大學。因南音一心想考龍城理工，蘇遠智怕告訴南音，南音會生氣，因此對南音撒謊。西決到醫院探望大伯，忽然發現東霓在婦科門口等待做流產手術.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 機電創科．勇奪國際11奬 | 機電工程署
programme.desc: 機電署「日內瓦發明展」一口氣橫掃 11 大獎. 地底機械狗、海洋發電全直擊！. 機電工程署在第51屆「日內瓦國際發明展」一口氣橫掃十一項大獎。節目主持走訪機電工程署總部，深入探討該署如何透過「機電創科網上平台」(E&M InnoPortal)扮演創新促成者角色。節目更會現場直擊得獎的金獎項目，包括地底密閉空間巡查的「機械狗隊」、海洋能源發電轉換器，以及守護醫療環境的 AI 故障檢測系統，探究科技如何賦能政府優化服務，改變市民生活。.

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 3
programme.desc: 大廚Gordon Ramsay到了芬蘭北部的納蘭地區，在這午夜太陽之地探索美食秘密。正值盛夏，Ramsay到這裡的沼澤區踢足球、在河中激流划艇、以傳統方式捕魚、更在桑拿小屋裡煮食。他採集了樹木焦油及蟻尿，又在沼澤採摘食材後，就到河邊與米芝蓮名廚Kim Mikkola一較高下，一同預備一頓盛宴。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年2月18日 星期二晚，10時30分 Chef Ramsay explores the land of the midnight sun and the sprawling wetlands of Lapland in Northern Finland, at the height of summer to learn its culinary secrets. He plays swamp football, navigates fierce rapids in a raft, fishes for white fish and cooks in a sauna. After sampling tar and ant’s urine and foraging in swamps, he goes head to head against Michelin rated chef, Kim Mikkola, to prepare a riverside feast. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2025.2.18 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十二集：家麗和媽媽美心起了衝突
programme.desc: 何文氏去世後的第一個春節，建國和家麗計劃將美心接到小年家裏過，家麗回老宅和美心商量，卻見到美心在收拾何文氏的遺物，家麗和奶奶的感情最為深厚，她十分激烈地和美心起了衝突.

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：家喜慫恿媽媽讓大姐家麗搬出去
programme.desc: 家喜的房子賣給家藝後，開始慫恿着美心快點讓家麗搬出去，以便自己回來住。家麗也明白家喜的意思，開始和建國考慮接下來的打算。家歡終於離開了看守所，方濤和成成為她慶祝，但家歡一直情緒不佳，方濤一直努力安慰家歡.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師和賽思對着電視觀看《活力健身》節目時，興致勃勃地準備開始健身。不巧的是，遙控器壞了。不過，這難不倒尋古大師，他立刻奔跑離開，尋找另一個遙控器。畫面一轉，我們來到二十世紀，尋古大師與一眾發明家相遇，包括尼古拉·特斯拉及托雷斯·奎維多，他們曾研發出利用無線電波操控的裝置。然而，直到 1950 年，首款電視遙控器才正式面世。「懶骨頭」誕生了。這款遙控器很快被「閃控器」取代，隨後又演進為「太空遙控器」。1980 年，一款革命性的遙控器問世，首次採用了紅外線技術，為家庭娛樂帶來嶄新體驗。究竟尋古大師能否及時趕回，與賽思一同參加健身課程呢.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 小佩莉特的手臂打了石膏。尋古大師前來醫院探望她，但他悄悄離開，帶領我們一同探索這項傑出發明的誕生歷程。最初的石膏固定器是由木製支架構成，然而這種方式並不實用。其後，人們改用含有蛋白的混合物製作。直到十九世紀，含有石膏與樹脂的布條才開始被廣泛使用，成為主流材料。尋古大師甚至會協助部分醫生利用3D打印技術製作石膏模型.

After sampling tar and ant’s urine and foraging in swamps, he goes head to head against Michelin rated chef, Kim Mikkola, to prepare a riverside feast. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2025.2.18 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師和賽思對着電視觀看《活力健身》節目時，興致勃勃地準備開始健身。不巧的是，遙控器壞了。不過，這難不倒尋古大師，他立刻奔跑離開，尋找另一個遙控器。畫面一轉，我們來到二十世紀，尋古大師與一眾發明家相遇，包括尼古拉·特斯拉及托雷斯·奎維多，他們曾研發出利用無線電波操控的裝置。然而，直到 1950 年，首款電視遙控器才正式面世。「懶骨頭」誕生了。這款遙控器很快被「閃控器」取代，隨後又演進為「太空遙控器」。1980 年，一款革命性的遙控器問世，首次採用了紅外線技術，為家庭娛樂帶來嶄新體驗。究竟尋古大師能否及時趕回，與賽思一同參加健身課程呢.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 小佩莉特的手臂打了石膏。尋古大師前來醫院探望她，但他悄悄離開，帶領我們一同探索這項傑出發明的誕生歷程。最初的石膏固定器是由木製支架構成，然而這種方式並不實用。其後，人們改用含有蛋白的混合物製作。直到十九世紀，含有石膏與樹脂的布條才開始被廣泛使用，成為主流材料。尋古大師甚至會協助部分醫生利用3D打印技術製作石膏模型.

programme.title: 家·我心我城
programme.sub-title: 第八集：東霓承諾西決會生下這個孩子
programme.desc: 東霓和西決一番談話後，東霓感覺弟弟長大了，她讓西決放心，她會生下這個孩子。小叔想要退出公開課的競選及辭職。原來，自從帶陳嫣上門後，小叔始終無法坦然地面對三叔三嬸和西決。他想跟陳嫣去陽城。陳嫣要求小叔上完公開課再辭職。西決將他的公開課的名額讓給小叔.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
31看世界 - 鬥快去北美
programme.desc: 競速前往終點聖約翰斯市的比賽正在進行中，五支隊伍離開了原住民島嶼海達瓜依，他們將踏入荒野，穿越育空地區的腹地，前往第二個中途站道森市。這是一個在1898年克朗代克淘金熱期間建立的新興城鎮。如要到達道森市，就要穿越超過2000公里路向北進發，駛進世界上最偏遠的公路之一。這片遼闊的荒野只偶爾有一些小型聚居點或油站。在極少公共交通可以利用的情況下，參賽者們將不得不穿越茂密的森林和廣闊的冰原.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集：家喜哄騙取得媽媽的房子
programme.desc: 家喜發現菜場上有人花錢收方子，剛好也問了美心，但美心沒有告訴家喜實情。家喜跟宏宇抱怨原來美心一直防着自己，醬菜方子這個事留了一手。家喜擔心美心日後又被大姐家麗哄回去，決定先下手為強.

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：小年炒期貨欠下巨債
programme.desc: 李雯哭着前來找家麗建國，原來是小年借高利貸炒期貨，欠下巨債，走投無路之下來向父母借錢，建國家麗被小年的糊塗行為氣的渾身發抖，狠狠教訓了一頓小年。但畢竟是自己親生的孩子，家麗和建國為了孩子到處借錢還債.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師很高興去海邊，但在機場，熱成像攝影機偵測到他發燒了。他被禁止登機！為了證明自己沒有生病，尋古大師決定找人給他量體溫……就像公元前400年他的朋友希波克拉底那樣。但由於沒有任何儀器，他的診斷充其量只是大概的。尋古大師追溯了體溫測量標準和醫用溫度計的演變。但從1870年到現代，每種型號都顯示他發燒了！尋古大師的假期計劃似乎打了折扣，除非.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 無論是搭乘計程車、馬車或騎自行車，尋古大師都會穿越時空，從綠燈到紅燈，講解交通燈的起源。最初是簡單的木製標誌，後來是聲音訊號，到 20 世紀才發展成為燈光。尋古大師解釋了紅色、橙色、綠色三種顏色的起源。在他的旅程中，他會發現專為視障人士設計的會說話的交通燈、會向未停車司機發出交通罰單的“智能”紅燈，甚至還有專為駱駝設計的交通燈.

programme.title: 家·我心我城
programme.sub-title: 第九集：西決與江薏暗生情愫
programme.desc: 南音跟蘇遠智說，她跟家裡鬧翻了。將來去了廣州，她就只有蘇遠智了。蘇遠智表示為了南音他決定轉而報考龍城理工。小叔和陳嫣結婚領了證，請全家吃飯。婚宴頭一天，陳嫣向西決道歉，西決接受陳嫣的道歉。西決脫口而出，邀請江薏女朋友邀請江薏以女朋友跟他一起去婚宴.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 斯洛文尼亞
programme.desc: 主持菲臘高拿前往斯洛文尼亞，一個夾在海洋與山之間的歐洲小國。搭火車探索這個鮮為人知的國家，該是最好的玩法吧？他乘坐一列小型採礦火車，深入山脈內部探索。這裏除了日常通勤的火車，還有較為特別的爬山火車，承載著汽車的載運火車，在古老的鐵軌上行駛，歷史可追溯到奧匈帝國時期。 Philippe Gougler is off to Slovenia, a small European country wedged between sea and mountains. And what better way to discover this little-known country than by train? To begin with, he climbs aboard a small mine train that takes him deep into the mountains to discover sunken tunnels. Then there are the everyday trains, and the more unusual ones that climb the mountains, with cars and auto-trains on board, running on tracks dating back to the Austro-Hungarian era.

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十六集：姊妹們因為老房子吵了起來
programme.desc: 這次姊妹見面，不想照顧美心的事情沒商量出個頭緒，姊妹們卻因為老房子的歸屬問題吵了起來。但美心明顯偏心家喜，家麗家文傷心離去。家喜態度蠻橫地向家麗索要小年欠下的兩萬塊錢，並口出惡言.

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十七集：家喜態度惡劣地追問媽媽的配方
programme.desc: 南方商人一再催促，家喜態度惡劣地追問美心醬菜的配方，甚至不惜找小混混恐嚇威脅美心，美心崩潰之下把配方交了出去，但自己也被氣到住院。家麗和建國把美心接到自家、悉心照料.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師在小賽思的生日當天送給她一個望遠鏡，並和她一起穿越時空，探索這個望遠鏡的起源，這個望遠鏡至今仍在幫助我們理解宇宙。 17 世紀，他們遇到了一位荷蘭人，他發明了第一個觀測遠方的器具：望遠鏡！這項發明後來被著名天文學家伽利略改進，人們得以看到以前肉眼看不見的星星。同樣著名的艾碩.牛頓進一步發展了望遠鏡，很快，望遠鏡就被送上太空！小賽思和尋古大師一定不會錯過前往太空欣賞哈勃太空望遠鏡的機會.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師去餐廳吃飯，卻發現所謂的「特色菜」不過是一道微波爐加熱的菜餚……更糟的是，餐廳老闆阿減和阿勞甚至不會用微波爐！如果尋古大師想吃熱菜餚，就得教他們怎麼用微波爐。微波爐是如何加熱食物的？尋古大師和兩位未來的餐廳老闆親眼見證了微波爐是如何在1946年被一位名叫珀西·斯賓塞的美國人偶然發現的，當時他正在研究一種雷達系統！最初，微波爐是奢侈品，但很快地它們就出現在家家戶戶的廚房裡，並引領了新的消費潮流.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群 第二季
programme.sub-title: 第四集：果寧和嘉彧比賽
programme.desc: 上學路上，果寧不服，想和嘉彧交量。果寧與白小天諷刺嘉彧，不料被嘉彧聽見了。於是嘉彧主動提出，只要果寧贏了她任何一項事情，班長之位就拱手讓給他。但倘若果寧輸了，便得當着全班面前叫她：「姐姐」！結果….

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: 上學不怕 | 新學年不願上學? 解構學童焦慮成因
programme.desc: #新學年，#學童開學的緊張，可以轉化為成長的動力。 開學初期是學童情緒波動較大的時期，不少學校已推行#小一適應週、#升中銜接課程等計劃，以減低學童的不安感；至於有#特殊教育需要的學生，他們的開學準備往往需要更多心思與支援。 本集走訪前線教育工作者、家長與學生，分享心路歷程，專家亦會拆解開學壓力的成因，提供正面應對方法.

programme.sub-title: 第四集：果寧和嘉彧比賽
programme.desc: 上學路上，果寧不服，想和嘉彧交量。果寧與白小天諷刺嘉彧，不料被嘉彧聽見了。於是嘉彧主動提出，只要果寧贏了她任何一項事情，班長之位就拱手讓給他。但倘若果寧輸了，便得當着全班面前叫她：「姐姐」！結果….

programme.title: 十八好時光
programme.sub-title: 非遺紙紮燈籠｜跨代共融話劇｜E Major合奏團｜大館拍住上展覽｜ 9月24日
programme.desc: 十八好時光.

programme.title: 消失的兇手
programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 可疑的小食店老闆
programme.desc: 原來小食店老闆蔣廣善軟禁了死裏逃生的聶小雨。當日打劫衛蔣廣善的劫匪找到了，他曾被蔣廣善刺傷，從傷口來看，蔣廣善是個左撇子。衛國平經過一系列的調查分析，懷疑蔣廣善跟割喉惡魔有關。同時衛國平想起有件跟薛家健有關的案件線索，但又想不起詳情.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 斯洛文尼亞
programme.desc: 主持菲臘高拿前往斯洛文尼亞，一個夾在海洋與山之間的歐洲小國。搭火車探索這個鮮為人知的國家，該是最好的玩法吧？他乘坐一列小型採礦火車，深入山脈內部探索。這裏除了日常通勤的火車，還有較為特別的爬山火車，承載著汽車的載運火車，在古老的鐵軌上行駛，歷史可追溯到奧匈帝國時期。 Philippe Gougler is off to Slovenia, a small European country wedged between sea and mountains. And what better way to discover this little-known country than by train? To begin with, he climbs aboard a small mine train that takes him deep into the mountains to discover sunken tunnels. Then there are the everyday trains, and the more unusual ones that climb the mountains, with cars and auto-trains on board, running on tracks dating back to the Austro-Hungarian era.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: 上學不怕 | 新學年不願上學? 解構學童焦慮成因
programme.desc: #新學年，#學童開學的緊張，可以轉化為成長的動力。 開學初期是學童情緒波動較大的時期，不少學校已推行#小一適應週、#升中銜接課程等計劃，以減低學童的不安感；至於有#特殊教育需要的學生，他們的開學準備往往需要更多心思與支援。 本集走訪前線教育工作者、家長與學生，分享心路歷程，專家亦會拆解開學壓力的成因，提供正面應對方法.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師在小賽思的生日當天送給她一個望遠鏡，並和她一起穿越時空，探索這個望遠鏡的起源，這個望遠鏡至今仍在幫助我們理解宇宙。 17 世紀，他們遇到了一位荷蘭人，他發明了第一個觀測遠方的器具：望遠鏡！這項發明後來被著名天文學家伽利略改進，人們得以看到以前肉眼看不見的星星。同樣著名的艾碩.牛頓進一步發展了望遠鏡，很快，望遠鏡就被送上太空！小賽思和尋古大師一定不會錯過前往太空欣賞哈勃太空望遠鏡的機會.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師去餐廳吃飯，卻發現所謂的「特色菜」不過是一道微波爐加熱的菜餚……更糟的是，餐廳老闆阿減和阿勞甚至不會用微波爐！如果尋古大師想吃熱菜餚，就得教他們怎麼用微波爐。微波爐是如何加熱食物的？尋古大師和兩位未來的餐廳老闆親眼見證了微波爐是如何在1946年被一位名叫珀西·斯賓塞的美國人偶然發現的，當時他正在研究一種雷達系統！最初，微波爐是奢侈品，但很快地它們就出現在家家戶戶的廚房裡，並引領了新的消費潮流.

programme.title: 家·我心我城
programme.sub-title: 第十集：大伯病情惡化，東霓要裴總幫忙
programme.desc: 東霓責怪江薏不該放任自己的情感，因為西決是個很容易認真的人。江薏告訴東霓，其實她與丈夫早已分居辦離婚。江薏轉而問到東霓與方靖的近況，點評東霓對方靖暉像是生意夥伴。南音跟西決哭訴她真的很喜歡蘇遠智，西決開導南音。大伯病情突然惡化，東霓要裴總幫忙.

programme.sub-title: 第1集 千里之堤 潰於蟻穴
programme.desc: 「千里之堤，潰於蟻穴」這句典故的引申含義是容易忽視的細節往往能成為致命的問題，也在數千年裏不斷警醒眾生。然而，小小的蟻穴真的能使千里之堤崩潰嗎？帶着這樣的疑問，多檔文化、科學類節目主持人高澤民將作為求證人，穿越古今，考究典故背後的科學真相.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 一位劍客正在躲避仇人的追殺，只見他俯下身來，耳朵緊貼地面，判斷着敵人的位置和距離。這樣的絕技絕非小說家的杜撰，在北宋沈括的科學著作《夢溪筆談》中有這樣的記載：“古法以牛革為矢服，臥則以為枕，取其中虛，附地枕之，數里內有人馬聲，則皆聞之。這就是伏地聽聲.
